properties.site-address: Hawkesbury Pump House, Heritage Drive, Hawkesbury
properties.notes: The site is a small area of hardstanding used partly as a carpark and open space. The site is part of the old Engine House. The site is located in a residential estate.. Site assessed as being deliverable in the SHLAA 2016. Allocated as a proposed Non-strategic site in the Borough Plan 2011-2031 Publication (2017)
